_note: Mandatory step between creating custom rules and creating the detector. Without it the detector matches nothing - it is the single most common reason a custom Security Analytics detector looks broken. Aliases must not collide with existing field names, which is why the Sigma rules use ToolName rather than gen_ai.tool.name. index_name is filled in by bin/detect.py with the concrete backing index, because aliases are applied per index and traces-agent-demo is a data stream.
